title: Electrocatalytic oxygen evolution reaction on LaNiO3 with tunable oxygen content under dual magnetic and light fields
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01578B, Paper
Ji Qi, Kaixin Zhu, Weiguang Ma, Hefeng Zhang, Ming Feng, Xu Zong
The enhanced OER activity of LNO thin films under dual magnetic and light fields primarily stems from the generation of photogenerated electron–hole pairs and the formation of triplet-state oxygen species.
